rationale: Both Konstantin and Leon work at the intersection of brand entertainment and storytelling—Konstantin as CEO of DreamInk in brand entertainment and product placement, and Leon as Head of Storytelling at Fictiv. Their complementary roles (founder/operator vs. narrative strategist) create a natural opportunity to explore how storytelling and brand strategy can amplify entertainment-focused products.
intro_message: Konstantin, meet Leon Zhang, Head of Storytelling at Fictiv — you two should connect on how narrative strategy intersects with brand entertainment.
